heroHeadline: NNPC Reforms Credited with $15.33bn in Petroleum Sector Remittances
heroSubtitle: A cholera outbreak rages across 7 LGAs in Borno State (39 dead, 4,204 cases by June 2) as a Nigeria-US joint AFRICOM strike kills 21 ISWAP fighters in Kukawa LGA on May 30 — bringing the May total to 240+ insurgents eliminated. Retired Major General Rabe Batsari and wife remain in bandit captivity in Katsina after kidnappers rejected ransom in favor of a prisoner-exchange demand. Forty-six Oyo State school hostages (39 pupils, 7 teachers) are still held after three weeks with NUT on indefinite strike and protests spreading to Osun State. On the political front, Tinubu commissioned three Nigerian Navy warships and a Gulf of Guinea regional maritime task force on June 1, and is set to address a joint session of the National Assembly on June 12 — Democracy Day.
footerNote: Data sourced from official Nigerian government records, major international outlets, and institutional analyses. Casualty figures are contested and drawn from multiple independent sources.
